note: S-01: a Restore job without bootstrap fails before any daemon contact (restore.cc DoNativeRestore M_FATAL); never a bootstrap built from the catalog
steps: select type,level,jobstatus,jobfiles,jobbytes,joberrors,clientid,comment from job where name='RestoreFiles' order by jobid desc limit 1;
